acceptance_evidence: Commit 63ef625ecb91 ("test(client-digest): cover feature-flag branches (PII routing + kill-switch)", 2026-05-08T17:21:29Z) adds the ON-branch test for CLIENT_DIGEST_REAL_RECIPIENTS in this exact spec file; commit message explicitly says 'Addresses PR #1838 review feedback (HIGH)'.
description: All tests in digest-queue.processor.spec.ts hardcode the CLIENT_DIGEST_REAL_RECIPIENTS feature flag to false, so the ON branch that routes drafts to the real attorney.email (vs. the jane@manifestlabs.com test fallback mailbox) had zero coverage. An inverted conditional in a future refactor could silently route every attorney's PII-bearing drafts to a single internal mailbox undetected.

acceptance_evidence: Same commit 63ef625ecb91 adds a dispatch-queue.processor.spec.ts test asserting addBulk is called with an empty array when the CLIENT_DIGEST kill-switch flag is OFF.
description: Both dispatch-queue tests hardcode the CLIENT_DIGEST master kill-switch flag to true, leaving the OFF branch (which should suppress all digest dispatch) completely untested. A regression that inverted this conditional would silently dispatch digests to every eligible attorney-client pair even before rollout begins.

acceptance_evidence: Commit 0509a6e3377e ("fix(client-digest): cap subject length with ellipsis truncation", 2026-05-08T17:26:23Z) adds a 160-char truncation with ellipsis in buildClientDigestSubject plus a new client-digest-subject.spec.ts; commit message: 'Addresses PR #1838 review feedback (MEDIUM)'.
description: buildClientDigestSubject returns `Weekly Update for ${clientName} | ${weekOf}` with no length guard, so an unusually long client name (up to ~64 chars via the email fallback) could push the result past the DigestContentSchema's `.max(160)` cap. Since the schema's parse is never actually invoked on the assembled digest object in the processor, that cap is dead enforcement, making the overflow silent rather than caught.

acceptance_evidence: Commit 5d580c7ef41c ("feat(client-digest): rebalance email header hierarchy + guard empty key-details", 2026-05-08T21:29:28Z) wraps the SectionBlock in a length guard; commit message explicitly notes 'The reviewer's red regression test in digest-template.renderer.spec.ts goes green. (N1)'.
description: When the LLM returns an empty keyDetailsDiscussed array (schema allows `.min(0)`), the template still rendered the 'Some key details discussed' section header above an empty bullet list, producing a visibly broken empty card in the email. The sibling NeedsList component already had an empty-state fallback; BulletList did not.

acceptance_evidence: PR author replied directly (comment 3210340574, 2026-05-08T17:37:04Z) declining the request: the active/closed filter runs inside the DB query so a unit test can't exercise the drop, and a real regression guard would need an integration test which the author didn't want to bundle into this PR. No mixed-status or closed-only fixture was added to dispatch-queue.processor.spec.ts in any later commit.
description: The two existing dispatch tests cover 'client has an ACTIVE case' and 'client has no cases' but not the two boundary cases that actually stress the D-2 ACTIVE-only filter: a client with both ACTIVE and CLOSED/ON_HOLD cases (should still be included) and a client with only CLOSED/ON_HOLD cases (should be excluded). If the ACTIVE predicate were accidentally widened or dropped, the existing tests would not catch it.
